Commentary.Commentary: Right then. The presentation ceremony comes to an end. Now, Hashmatullah Shahidi collects the trophy and waits for his team to gather around and start the celebrations. Smiles across the faces of the Afghanistan players. They have not only won the series but have also moved up to the second spot in the World Cup Super League standings. Well, we have more action coming your way from Zimbabwe, as these two side meet in a three-match T20I series. The first match will begin at 1630 IST (1100 GMT). But as you all know you can join us early for the build-up. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Rahmat Shah wins the player of the series award for his exceptional feat with the blade. He agrees by saying that he did come with an ambition to win the Player of the Series in this tournament. Mentions the team came in here to win three games and he is glad he could contribute for his side. Mentions that they also arrived a bit early to this country which helped them to get familiar with the conditions.

Rashid Khan win the Man of the Match award. He says it was all about the bowling today. They tried to keep it simple and credits the way Mujeeb bowled and also the whole bowling attack who did really well. Mentions it was a difficult wicket to bat on and you need to be prepared on this wicket. Adds they bowled well too but they knew the target and they made it easier.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the victorious skipper is in for a chat. He starts by saying it is a really proud moment for him and the team. Mentions there are a few bruises on his fingers but says it is worth it when you play for your country. Further says, Nabi will be the one to lead the side in T20I series and wishes him all the best.

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe, says the wicket today was the toughest and the bowlers came out fighting which gave them a small chance. States the bowlers were good and the batting was decent in parts. Adds they need to come up with a solution, they do not have a lot of time but they need to. Credits Blessing for the way he bowled.
Presentation time...

For Zimbabwe, Muzarabani and Chatara were brilliant with the new ball. They provided their team just the start they wanted but the others did not impress. Yes, Burl and Myers did get a wicket but it was a little too late. However, the bowlers can’t be blamed. It was their batters who let them down as they were bundled out for a very low score in the first half.

For Afghanistan, it was just about two batters doing well and it was Nabi and Shahidi who stepped up. They did keep losing wickets at regular intervals but two decent knocks is what it took for their side to get over the line. It wasn’t easy but the important thing is they eventually got there.

Afghanistan have finally, crawled their way to the target and have completed the whitewash! Credit to Zimbabwe though they really made the visitors work hard for the target. Maybe another 60 or 70 runs and the game could have well been different.

SIX! BOOM! There it is, Mohammad Nabi scores the winning runs here. It is short and on off. Nabi stays back and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. AFGHANISTAN WIN THE GAME BY 4 WICKETS.
Short again and wide this time. Mohammad Nabi hits it well but stopped well by the diving point fielder.
Slightly short and on middle stump. Punches off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Floats the ball towards the leg stump. Rashid Khan works it off his leg fine of square leg. Brilliant effort from Dion Myers as he saves a boundary.
Full and on middle, Rashid Khan flicks it past mid-wicket. The fielder chases it. Three runs taken.
Outside off, this is cut to point for one.
Length and outside off, this is driven past covers for a brace.
On off, Mohammad Nabi cuts it to short third man and straight towards the fielder.
Outside off and on a length, Mohammad Nabi looks to play at it but misses.
FOUR! Inching closer to the finish line now. Shorter and on middle, Mohammad Nabi pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller, on leg. Khan goes down and sweeps it to short fine leg. No run taken. Just a single and a wicket off it. Can Zimbabwe build on this momentum?
Rashid Khan comes in to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Azmatullah Omarzai is gutted with himself. Another man bites the dust for Afghanistan and that too at the wrong time. It looks like this fixture is coming back to life. Burl goes short and outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai tries to cut it away on the back foot. He does so but straight to the fielder at short cover. Dion Myers takes a sharp catch there.
Commentary.Howout: c Dion Myers b Ryan Burl

Looped up, around off, defended out.

Floated and full, outside off. Nabi defends it to point.
Back of a length, outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai cuts it to covers. A great over by Chatara just a single off it.
Four dots in a row now! Length, on off, blocked out.

A single to end the over! It is flatter, around middle. Nabi goes back and punches it down to long on for another single. 20 short of the target now.
Fuller, on off. Azmatullah Omarzai defends it to point for a quick single.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Azmatullah Omarzai drives it to cover but not in the gap.
On middle and leg. Omarzai tucks it to square leg.
It is full and on off. Azmatullah Omarzai blocks it out watchfully.
A single now as this is worked towards point.
Outside off and fuller, Azmatullah Omarzai defends it to short covers.
FOUR! Short and wide from the bowler Azmatullah Omarzai doesn't miss out, connects well, and dispatches it past short cover for a good boundary!
On a length and on off, Azmatullah Omarzai cuts it towards backward point and straight towards the fielder.
FOUR! Fuller and down the middle, Azmatullah Omarzai flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length and outside off, Azmatullah Omarzai hits it straight towards the fielder at covers.
Azmatullah Omarzai is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The set batsman departs, just what Zimbabwe wanted! Dion Myers comes around the wicket to the left-hander, bowls on a good length just outside off stump and moving away from the batsman. Hashmatullah Shahidi drives hard at it and gets an outside edge to the wicket keeper. The back bone of the Afghanistan innings walks back now. Has he done enough for his side to get over line?
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Dion Myers

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and outside off, this is punched to covers for one.
On middle, blocked.
Outside off this time, Mohammad Nabi makes room for himself and cuts it to point for one.
Much flatter and on off, this is blocked towards mid-wicket.
On middle, defended towards mid on.

NOT OUT! Zimbabwe use a review but in vain. Although, the skipper and the bowler could see the funny side of it. It is around middle with a hint of turn, Mohammad Nabi comes down the track and looks to play at it but misses as the ball hits his pads. A loud appeal but the finger stays down. Zimbabwe take a review but it does not go their way.

Review! Wesley Madhevere convinces his skipper to take the review. The original decision is not out. The replays confirm no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows the impact is umpire's call and the ball is also missing the wickets.
Short ball on middle stump. Mohammad Nabi pulls it to square leg for an easy single.
Around the wicket to the left hand batter. Angling into the body from a good length. Hashmatullah Shahidi plays it to mid-wicket for a single.

Fuller and on the pads. Mohammad Nabi nudges it to mid-wicket.
Short and wide from the bowler. Mohammad Nabi slashes hard through point. Diving save at the boundary from the fielders restricts them to a brace.

Oh dear! The physio sprints out once again on the field. This time to nurse Hashmatullah Shahidi, who is groaning as he is down on the floor at the non-striker's end. Till the time he is getting his treatment, the others take a drinks break. Zimbabwe put up a great fight with the ball and had Afghanistan under the pump. Although the visiting side have got their noses in front thanks to this stand between Shahidi and Nabi. They would hope these two batters are able to see them over the line.

Back of a length down the leg side, Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to flick it but the ball hits his ribs and rolls towards square leg. Leg bye taken. Slight halt in play as Hashmatullah Shahidi looks in pain
Change. Dion Myers is the new man in.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed towards mid off.
On off, defended.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed towards covers for one.
On middle, defended.

Outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to play at it but misses.

Good length delivery outside off stump. Defended to the cover fielder.
LEG BYE! Back of length onto the pads, Hashmatullah Shahidi misses the ball and it goes off his thigh pad to mid-wicket. They collect a leg bye.
Fuller outside off stump. Mohammad Nabi tries a booming drive but only manages a thick outside edge through the gully area.

Much fuller and on middle, Mohammad Nabi flicks it towards mid-wicket.

On middle, defended.

Outside off, this is defended towards covers.
Much fuller and on middle, this is defended towards mid off.
Goes full again and across the batsman. Leaves it well alone.

Short and into the body. Mohammad Nabi swings his bat and gets a single square of fine leg.

Back of a length and outside off, this is punched towards the off side for a quick single.
On off this time, this is defended towards the on side.
On middle and on a full length, this is guided towards ong off for one.
On middle, defended.
On middle with a hint of turn, this is guided towards covers.
Flatter and on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi guides it to extra cover for one.

Full length, on off. Shahidi drives it to covers.

A sharp bouncer, on middle and leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi tries to pull it away but misses.

The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards second slips. Craig Ervine there keeps his eyes on the ball and gathers the catch sharply. Delight for Zimbabwe. This has been a great fightback from the hosts so far. Najibullah Zadran is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Blessing Muzarabani

Back of a length, outside off, shaping away. Shah looksto chase it but misses.
